newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan environment-related shares extend gains.
newsitem.headline: Japan environment-related shares extend gains.

text.p: Shares of companies that make environment-oriented machinery or equipment rose on Thursday morning, extending the previous day's gains on expectations that the government will tighten regulations on toxic emissions, traders said.
Shares of Nihon Spindle Mfg Co Ltd briefly hit 532, a new high for this calendar year. They traded five yen higher at 518 at 0105 GMT.
HEC Corp also briefly marked a new 1997 high of 1,780. It later eased to 10 yen higher at 1,700.
Shares of Takuma Co Ltd also briefly rose to 1,590, a new 1997 high. They traded unchanged at 1,570 by 0126 GMT.

Traders expect tighter rules on dioxin emissions. They said an Environment Agency committee is expected to decide later this month to recommend new controls on emissions of the highly toxic product by industrial incinerators.
